svg.aria-label: Commit Metro: my last 53 weeks of GitHub contributions as Namma Metro trains on the purple line, one train per week and one coach per day, with lit windows for days I committed. 201 contributions since 05 Oct. Stations are my busiest repos: vfd-explorer, tripppyyy, Alpha-Fin, Vyuha-Network, AllergySafe. The line ends at Commit Street, where $VJK trades at ₹57.60.
